The model cannot put an option forward yet, because it could not test your requirement of monthly churn below 4%.

- The comparison is moderately robust within its assumptions, but it rests partly on Olumi-authored estimates and on **Non‑Pro MRR defaulting to £0/month** because no value was recorded.
- The model’s outcome is most structurally sensitive to active Pro subscribers; it is also affected by monthly churn, new Pro sign-ups, and perceived feature value. These are provisional model inputs, not validated evidence.
- The next reasoning step is to make the churn constraint measurable in the model; until then, the £20k MRR and churn requirements cannot be assessed together.
